name: Manoranjan Sahoo / ମନୋରଞ୍ଜନ ସାହୁ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Manoranjan Sahoo is an Odia poet from Indupur in Kendrapara, Odisha. His collections include Apadebata, Khalihatare and Kichhi Kabita Kichhi Nirabata. Poems translated by Pitambar Naik in Prachya Review bring his observations of hunger, fear and public life to English readers.

His Kabita Live poem ‘ପବନ’ follows something that ordinarily refuses to stay: the wind. Within a flute, breath meets the touch of lips and fingers and discovers another life as music. The short, descending lines slow that movement, allowing an image of freedom to become one of intimacy and renewal.
